---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new probe, template, output format, or improvement
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem / motivation

What are you trying to do that Penthera doesn't support today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. If it's a new check, what vulnerability class or
misconfiguration does it detect, and how would it confirm a hit (to avoid false
positives)?

## Scope

- [ ] New black-box probe (URL scan)
- [ ] New white-box check (repo scan)
- [ ] New template / plugin
- [ ] Output / reporting (Markdown, JSON, SARIF, compliance mapping)
- [ ] Developer experience / CLI
- [ ] Other

## Alternatives considered

Anything you've tried or ruled out.
